service.name: infrastructure-manager
service.description: Reliability instrument for the infra-health team: joins the sensor-map setpoint against live plant readings and emits one ranked, trust-qualified error surface

vrooli-autoheal.description: Primary sensor source: uptime, alarm flood, restart frequency, heal outcomes and heal-loop incidence, plus the check registry that `supervision` reconciles and two of four trust rules. Read-only; this scenario never shelves, restarts, retires or remediates.
vrooli-autoheal.degraded_behavior: Five targets report UNAVAILABLE with a stated reason and their trust verdicts degrade to UNTRUSTED; the remaining targets keep ranking.

storage-manager.description: Device census, growth slope and declared-ceiling coverage via `storage-manager infra-health --json`. Read-only; never triggers cleanup.
storage-manager.degraded_behavior: The storage growth-slope target reports UNAVAILABLE with a stated reason.

test-genie.description: Validation cost and cache-reliability aggregate via `runs cost`. Phase semantics stay with test-genie.
test-genie.degraded_behavior: The validation-cost target reports UNAVAILABLE with a stated reason.

system-monitor.description: Process attribution over a saturation window grouped by source scenario, plus investigation records. Read-only; never triggers an investigation.
system-monitor.degraded_behavior: Burst attribution reports UNAVAILABLE with a stated reason.

data-backup-manager.description: Backup freshness, coverage and verified-restore drill outcomes. Read-only; never runs a backup or a restore.
data-backup-manager.degraded_behavior: Backup targets report UNAVAILABLE with a stated reason.

agent-manager.description: Run statistics and durable error patterns backing the agent spawn-success target. Read-only.
agent-manager.degraded_behavior: The spawn-success target reports UNAVAILABLE with a stated reason.

scenario-dependency-analyzer.description: Core-set closure for the derived should-be-supervised set. Read-only derivation query executed per read.
scenario-dependency-analyzer.degraded_behavior: Supervision reconcile reports UNAVAILABLE. It must never fall back to a cached or enumerated roster — operating-model rule 6.
